title: Among locally funded charter schools that opened after January 1, 2005, ide
question: Among locally funded charter schools that opened after January 1, 2005, identify those whose SAT excellence rate exceeds 0.25. For these schools, return the administrator’s full name, school name, city, and the eligible free rate for students aged 5–17. Only include schools where this free rate is above the average eligible free rate (for ages 5–17) across all such qualifying schools.

prediction.sql:
WITH qualifying AS (
  SELECT
    s."XCL_041" AS cds,
    s."XCL_080" AS admin_first,
    s."XCL_081" AS admin_last,
    s."XCL_047" AS school_name,
    s."XCL_050" AS city,
    CAST(f."XCL_025" AS REAL) / f."XCL_024" AS free_rate_5_17
  FROM schools AS s
  JOIN frpm AS f ON f."XCL_001" = s."XCL_041"
  JOIN satscores AS t ON t."XCL_030" = s."XCL_041"
  WHERE s."XCL_065" = 'Locally funded'
    AND s."XCL_063" = 1
    AND s."XCL_061" > '2005-01-01'
    AND CAST(t."XCL_040" AS REAL) / t."XCL_036" > 0.25
)
SELECT
  q.admin_first,
  q.admin_last,
  q.school_name,
  q.city,
  q.free_rate_5_17
FROM qualifying AS q
WHERE q.free_rate_5_17 > (
  SELECT AVG(q2.free_rate_5_17)
  FROM qualifying AS q2
)

WITH qualifying AS (
  SELECT
    s."XCL_041" AS cds,
    s."XCL_080" AS admin_first,
    s."XCL_081" AS admin_last,
    s."XCL_047" AS school_name,
    s."XCL_050" AS city,
    CAST(f."XCL_025" AS REAL) / f."XCL_024" AS free_rate_5_17
  FROM schools AS s
  JOIN frpm AS f ON f."XCL_001" = s."XCL_041"
  JOIN satscores AS t ON t."XCL_030" = s."XCL_041"
  WHERE s."XCL_065" = 'Locally funded'
    AND s."XCL_063" = 1
    AND s."XCL_061" > '2005-01-01'
    AND CAST(t."XCL_040" AS REAL) / t."XCL_036" > 0.25
)
SELECT
  q.admin_first,
  q.admin_last,
  q.school_name,
  q.city,
  q.free_rate_5_17
FROM qualifying AS q
WHERE q.free_rate_5_17 > (
  SELECT AVG(q2.free_rate_5_17)
  FROM qualifying AS q2
)

Execution returned 5 rows with 5 columns and no truncation; the query plan shows indexed lookups for frpm and satscores, with no evidence of row multiplication.

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH q AS (
  SELECT s."XCL_047" AS admin,
         s."XCL_043" AS school_name,
         s."XCL_045" AS city,
         f."XCL_019" AS free_rate
  FROM schools AS s
  JOIN frpm AS f ON f."XCL_001" = s."XCL_041"
  JOIN satscores AS t ON t."XCL_030" = s."XCL_041"
  WHERE s."XCL_065" = 'Locally funded'
    AND s."XCL_044" = 'Charter'
    AND s."XCL_061" > '2005-01-01'
    AND t."XCL_040" > 0.25
)
SELECT admin, school_name, city, free_rate
FROM q
WHERE free_rate > (SELECT AVG(free_rate) FROM q)

    s."XCL_041" AS cds,
    s."XCL_080" AS admin_first,
    s."XCL_081" AS admin_last,
    s."XCL_047" AS school_name,
    s."XCL_050" AS city,
    CAST(f."XCL_025" AS REAL) / f."XCL_024" AS free_rate_5_17
  FROM schools AS s
  JOIN frpm AS f ON f."XCL_001" = s."XCL_041"
  JOIN satscores AS t ON t."XCL_030" = s."XCL_041"
  WHERE s."XCL_065" = 'Locally funded'
    AND s."XCL_063" = 1
    AND s."XCL_061" > '2005-01-01'
    AND CAST(t."XCL_040" AS REAL) / t."XCL_036" > 0.25
)
SELECT
  q.admin_first,
  q.admin_last,
  q.school_name,
  q.city,
  q.free_rate_5_17
FROM qualifying AS q
WHERE q.free_rate_5_17 > (
  SELECT AVG(q2.free_rate_5_17)
  FROM qualifying AS q2
)
